modules.title: 温度会改变同一请求的哪些回答？

example.label: 同一宣传语请求在不同温度趋势下的教学示例

steps.label: 较低设置：措辞趋于集中
steps.demo:
生成设置 · 教学示例
为待办应用写一句宣传语较低温度趋势
候选 A把今天的待办安排得更清楚。
候选 B让今天的任务安排更清楚。
观察意思相近；措辞仍有变化
steps.caption: 教学示例，不是实测：较低温度通常让候选更集中，但不会保证每个字都相同。

steps.label: 较高设置：变化通常更多
steps.demo:
生成设置 · 教学示例
同一条宣传语请求较高温度趋势
候选 A少一点遗忘，多一点从容。
候选 B把忙乱的一天，折进一张清单。
观察表达更分散；好坏仍要判断
steps.caption: 教学示例，不是实测：较高温度通常放大候选变化，不能保证新颖、有用或符合固定格式。

modules.title: 温度影响采样变化，不负责格式检查

items.title: 先确认接口支持
items.text: 在支持温度设置的模型和接口中，较低值通常更集中，较高值通常更多样；可用范围要查对应文档。

items.title: 固定格式需要另行约束
items.text: 即使温度较低，字段也可能缺失或出错。需要固定结构时，应定义格式并检查实际输出。

modules.title: 低温不等于逐字复现
modules.text: 温度调整的是采样变化的倾向，不是对相同句子、正确答案或固定格式的保证。

lessonPractice.title: 团队让 AI 给待办应用起名，结果总是很像。若接口支持温度设置，先试哪种方向？

options.label: 适当调高温度，再比较新一轮候选名称
options.feedback: 对。较高温度通常增加措辞变化，适合探索更多候选；它不保证每个结果都新颖或可用。

options.label: 调低温度，让候选名称之间差异更大
options.feedback: 较低温度通常让采样更集中，和扩大候选表达差异的目标相反。

options.label: 增加最大输出长度，让模型有更多字可写
options.feedback: 输出长度控制回答能写多长，不直接控制候选措辞的随机变化。

en.title: The team asks AI to name a to-do app, but the suggestions sound alike. If the API supports temperature, what should you try first?

options.label: Raise the temperature somewhat, then compare another set of names
options.feedback: Correct. Higher temperature usually increases wording variation for exploring candidates; it does not guarantee that every result is novel or useful.

options.label: Lower the temperature so the candidate names differ more
options.feedback: Lower temperature usually concentrates sampling, which works against the goal of exploring more varied wording.

options.label: Increase the maximum output length to give the model more words
options.feedback: Output length limits how much the answer can contain; it does not directly control sampling variation.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请先确认当前模型和接口支持温度设置，再为同一条起名请求比较不同设置下的候选。把结果当作随机程度的趋势观察，不要承诺低温会逐字重复；如果输出格式必须固定，请另外定义格式并检查结果。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: First check whether this model and API support temperature. Compare candidates for the same naming request at different settings, treating them as a trend in randomness rather than a guarantee that low temperature repeats every word. If the format must be fixed, define it separately and validate the result.

learning.assumes: You have seen repeated runs of the same request return different wording.
learning.outcome: You can choose a lower or higher randomness direction for a task and know it cannot guarantee a fixed format.

modules.title: How can temperature change answers to the same request?

modules.title: Temperature affects sampling, not format checks

items.title: First check API support
items.text: For models and APIs that support it, lower values usually concentrate sampling and higher values usually add variation. Check the relevant documentation for supported ranges.

items.title: Constrain a required format separately
items.text: A low setting can still produce missing or incorrect fields. Define the structure and validate the actual output.

modules.title: Low temperature does not mean identical wording
modules.text: Temperature shifts the tendency of sampling variation; it does not guarantee identical sentences, correct answers, or a fixed format.

distinctions.label: Maximum output length
distinctions.text: Maximum output length limits how much can be generated; temperature adjusts sampling randomness. More room does not make wording steadier.

distinctions.label: Structured output
distinctions.text: Temperature only affects sampling variation; JSON fields and types need a format constraint and checks on the actual result.
